comments.body:
One possible effect you can choose from the Crystal of Blessing item. See its page for details on obtaining it.

I've never used this myself, so here's a helpful video by CA Huseyin_Gazi demonstrating its awesome power: www.youtube.com/watch?v=m3G4rYroKlg

Cheers.

wiki:
Unlock Conditions: perform one successful Transmutation Alchemy recipe using Transmutation Alchemy Equipment OR Complex Alchemy Equipment furniture in your Quarters. Wind of Return item is easiest to produce and therefore recommended.

How to activate: Use Crystal of Blessing and select this blessing.

Effect: For 30 minutes, there is a chance that vigour will not be consumed when performing production (storage, casting, sewing, handicrafts, alchemy). The chance for success is related to its current rank.

Rank 1 the chance of occurrence is 33%; at Rank 2 the chance of occurrence is 66%; at Rank 3 the chance of occurrence is 100%.

Rank 1 (0-19 Crystals used): 33% chance vigor will not be consumed
Rank 2 (20-39 Crystals used): 66% chance vigor will not be consumed
Rank 3 (40+ Crystals used): 100% chance vigor will not be consumed
